title: Illuminated Kidney Grille Styling
summary: Feedback centers on the illuminated kidney grille and Iconic Glow, with praise for its nighttime appearance but many snippets that only mention the feature, ask about settings, or request its inclusion without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the illuminated grille’s look, especially its lighting effect at night and contribution to front-end styling.

negative.summary: The negative review says the illuminated kidney grilles make the vehicle look bulkier and more rounded.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined snippets mostly reference wanting the illuminated grille or Iconic Glow, asking how to activate it, or naming the feature without enough context to infer sentiment.

limitations: Many examples are too brief or lack enough context to determine sentiment clearly.
Some undetermined fragments describe feature requests or support interactions rather than evaluative feedback.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 feedback.
